title: Unraveling microstructure and mechanical response of an additively manufactured refractory TiVHfNbMo high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by direct energy deposition (DED) with laser power 2000 W, scanning speed 8 mm/s, powder delivery rate 11 g/min, layer thickness 0.5 mm, laser beam diameter 5 mm, line energy density 250 J/mm, argon atmosphere (oxygen <100 ppm), and substrate TC4 plate.
